headline: Zoning variances for a garage addition at 319 Hunt Street, and a pre-application presentation for a land development at 85 Hunt Street.
summary: The meeting covers a zoning application from Effuahson, LLC for 319 Hunt Street. It also includes a pre-application presentation by One Neighborhood Builders for 85 Hunt Street.
items: Old business: Application PZB-2026-09Z by Effuahson, LLC, of 40 Toronto Avenue, Providence, RI, for 319 Hunt Street (Assessor's Plat 3, Lot 121). The applicant proposes to build an addition to the existing principal garage and seeks a use variance to expand a legal nonconforming use.

Old business: The same application also seeks dimensional variances from rear-yard setback requirements, maximum lot coverage requirements, and Art. IV, Sec. 401.1(B), which requires a total open area of at least 800 square feet.
New business: Pre-application presentation by One Neighborhood Builders for a proposed major land development at 85 Hunt Street (AP 2, Lot 196), a property owned by the City of Central Falls.
location: The Bessette Building (DPW) – 1280 High Street, Central Falls, RI 02863
plain_text:
CITY OF CENTRAL FALLS 
                 COMBINED PLANNING AND ZONING BOARD 
 
 
Page 1 of 1 
REGULAR MEETING 
(PUBLIC HEARING) 
Wednesday, September 23, 2026 at 6:00 PM 
The Bessette Building (DPW) – 1280 High Street, Central Falls, RI 02863 
 
AGENDA 
I. Call to Order 
II. Roll Call 
III. Pledge of Allegiance 
IV. Approval of Minutes 
A.  Regular Meeting Minutes of July 22, 2026 
B.  Regular Meeting Minutes of August 26, 2026 
V. Public Comment 
VI. Old Business 
A.  Pursuant to its local and statutory authority as the Zoning Board, discussion and possible votes on 
      Application PZB-2026-09Z: 
Effuahson, LLC, of 40 Toronto Avenue, Providence, RI, represented by Jones Harris, Applicant 
for 319 Hunt Street (Assessor's Plat 3, Lot 121), proposes to construct an addition to the 
existing principal garage. The Applicant seeks a Use Variance to expand the legal 
nonconforming use and Dimensional Variances from rear-yard setback requirements (Art. IV, 
Sec. 401, R-3 Zone), maximum lot coverage requirements (Art. IV, Sec. 401, R -3 Zone), and 
from the requirements of Art. IV, Sec. 401.1(B) to permit a total open area of less than 800 
square feet on the subject property. 
VII. New Business 
A.  Pre-Application presentation by One Neighborhood Builders for a proposed Major Land 
      Development at 85 Hunt Street (AP 2, Lot 196), a property owned by the City of Central Falls. 
VIII. Adjournment 
Pursuant to Rhode Island General Laws § 42-46-4, the Board reserves the right to convene in executive session on any of the aforementioned items 
for one or more of the purposes listed in Rhode Island General Laws § 42-46-5(1)-(10).
